/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:88:   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-I3-code-review-r2.txt:558:    15	> **Cross-location asymmetry**: a value, schema, algorithm, or invariant exists in two or more places, and an edit to one location is not symmetrically applied to all peers, so behavior diverges silently.
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-I3-code-review-r2.txt:560:    17	Across 6 tracks + 5 close-ceremony fix iterations, codex 5.5 (`pr-gate`) caught **12 instances** of this meta-class (8 distinct failure-mode items + 4 close-ceremony reinforcements of items #6 and #8). Every PR that lasted ≥ 2 review rounds hit at least one instance. The pattern is so consistent that linear "fix the cited blocker, ship v_n+1" iteration would not have caught the second-order asymmetry; codex specifically catches the symmetric counterpart that the worker missed.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-FIX-B2-r2-code-review.txt:144:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:64:8. **Authority-document → generated/consumed surface audit**: When updating an authority document (ADR, spec, `agent-contract.md`, runbook, CONVENTIONS) **OR a dependency authority (`package.json`)** that mandates behavior in downstream consumers, audit every consumer-side replica/generated artifact for synchronized update **AND staged-in-the-git-index in the same bundle**. Specifically: an ADR section that says "X file MUST be updated to do Y" requires the same commit to update X and provide a way to verify the synchronization. Generated artifacts (e.g. `docs/review-checklist.md` and `.claude/agents/*.md` derived from `agent-contract.md`; **`pnpm-lock.yaml` derived from `package.json`** — see sub-form C below) MUST be regenerated via the documented codegen step (`pnpm generate:configs` / `pnpm install`) AND **explicitly `git add`'d** so the git **index** (not just the working tree) contains the new content; runbooks (`docs/runbooks/team-operations.md`) MUST be cross-linked; Codex/Claude subagent prompt files MUST embed or reference the new rule.
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-FIX-B2-r2-code-review.txt:145:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:88:   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-F-pr-gate-r2.txt:2746:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:56:4. **Consumer schema audit**: After defining a schema in a single-authority package (e.g. `@skb/content-types/frontmatterSchema`), audit every consumer for inline duplicates or inline redefinitions that should `import` instead. The "deferred swap" pattern — "I'll inline now and import later" — is a contract break that compounds over time. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 2 — apps/site/content.config.ts inlined `z.object(...)` rather than importing `frontmatterSchema`.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-F-pr-gate-r2.txt:2747:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:58:5. **Algorithm + runtime constant replication audit**: When an algorithm or runtime constant is replicated outside its authority (e.g. inline FOUC scripts, login challenge derivation, pre-hydration boot logic that cannot import from packages), audit every consumer-side replica for byte-equivalent reproduction. The replica must register a **regression test** that asserts equivalence against the authority across a representative input corpus. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 1 — FOUC IIFE truthy-coerce vs `getInitialTheme()` strict-whitelist; remediated with `apps/site/src/__tests__/fouc-script.test.ts` 16-row corpus.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-F-pr-gate-r2.txt:2748:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:62:7. **Exception-scope equivalence audit**: When replicating an algorithm + its exception handling across files, audit BOTH the happy-path semantics AND the `try/catch` scope between authority and replica. Narrow vs wide `try/catch` can produce divergent fall-through behavior even with identical happy-path logic. Specifically: when `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / `IndexedDB` / `matchMedia` / any browser API in the algorithm path can throw, the `try/catch` MUST wrap ONLY the throwing call, with the fall-through branch (matchMedia / system default / DOM apply) running AFTER the catch handler — not inside it. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #7 — FOUC IIFE wide-scope try/catch swallowed matchMedia exceptions; remediated with narrow try/catch + 2 storage-throws regression tests.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-F-pr-gate-r2.txt:2749:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:64:8. **Authority-document → generated/consumed surface audit**: When updating an authority document (ADR, spec, `agent-contract.md`, runbook, CONVENTIONS) **OR a dependency authority (`package.json`)** that mandates behavior in downstream consumers, audit every consumer-side replica/generated artifact for synchronized update **AND staged-in-the-git-index in the same bundle**. Specifically: an ADR section that says "X file MUST be updated to do Y" requires the same commit to update X and provide a way to verify the synchronization. Generated artifacts (e.g. `docs/review-checklist.md` and `.claude/agents/*.md` derived from `agent-contract.md`; **`pnpm-lock.yaml` derived from `package.json`** — see sub-form C below) MUST be regenerated via the documented codegen step (`pnpm generate:configs` / `pnpm install`) AND **explicitly `git add`'d** so the git **index** (not just the working tree) contains the new content; runbooks (`docs/runbooks/team-operations.md`) MUST be cross-linked; Codex/Claude subagent prompt files MUST embed or reference the new rule.
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-F-pr-gate-r2.txt:2750:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:68:   # 1. Edit authority + generator code
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-F-pr-gate-r2.txt:2751:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:82:   **Pitfall (this is the load-bearing step)**: `git status --short` shows two columns: column 1 is index-vs-HEAD; column 2 is working-tree-vs-index. After running the generator without `git add`, you see `' M'` (space + M) — **working tree differs from index, but index still matches HEAD**. `git commit` only commits the index. Skipping `git add` means the regenerated content is in your working tree but NOT in the next commit. The bundle would land authority + generator-code changes WITHOUT the regenerated outputs, leaving consumers (Wave 2 reviewers reading `.claude/agents/*.md`) at pre-update content. Use `git diff --cached` (not `git status`) as the canonical staging-verification command — `--cached` shows index-vs-HEAD only, which is what `git commit` will produce.
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-F-pr-gate-r2.txt:2752:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:84:   **Pitfall extension — `pnpm-lock.yaml` is a generated artifact too (sub-form C below)**: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump / `@types/*` shift), `pnpm install` regenerates `pnpm-lock.yaml` as a deterministic derived artifact. Skipping `git add pnpm-lock.yaml` produces the same class of failure as skipping `git add .claude/agents/*.md`: working tree has the synced lockfile but the **index** still holds HEAD's stale lockfile, so the bundle ships `package.json` ahead of its lockfile. CI runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` from the bundled state, sees the stale lockfile disagreeing with the new `package.json`, and fails install. The same `git diff --cached --stat -- pnpm-lock.yaml` canonical verification applies. (Wave 1 erratum commit `e15ec36`; codified as sub-form C below.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-F-pr-gate-r2.txt:2753:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:86:   Generated-from-authority files carry their own header comment ("GENERATED FROM agent-contract.md — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND") OR YAML frontmatter declaring authority source — both forms are acceptable. `pnpm-lock.yaml` lacks an explicit header (the format is fixed by pnpm) but is implicitly declared by `pnpm install`'s contract — its authority is `package.json` + the workspace `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:130:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:48:### The 8 items
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:131:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:50:1. **Field/attribute audit**: After adding a field to a data shape (Zod schema, Pydantic model, TS interface, mdast attrs, etc.), audit every comparator / equality / serialization / canonicalization function that handles this shape. /home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:132:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:52:2. **Status code audit**: After adding a status code to one HTTP handler (or, generally, an exit/error code to one branch), audit every other handler emitting the same code. RFC-mandated headers (RFC 7235 `WWW-Authenticate` on 401, RFC 7231 `Allow` on 405) attach to **the status code itself**, not the framework code path that emitted it. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #2 — custom `SkbError` 401 path missed `WWW-Authenticate`.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:133:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:54:3. **Strictness audit**: After adding `.strict()` (Zod) / `extra='forbid'` (Pydantic) at one level of an object schema, audit every nested object/sub-schema. The strictness setting **does not propagate**; nested objects must opt in independently. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #3 — top-level `.strict()` shipped while nested `frontmatterSchema` still silently stripped unknown keys.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:134:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:56:4. **Consumer schema audit**: After defining a schema in a single-authority package (e.g. `@skb/content-types/frontmatterSchema`), audit every consumer for inline duplicates or inline redefinitions that should `import` instead. The "deferred swap" pattern — "I'll inline now and import later" — is a contract break that compounds over time. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 2 — apps/site/content.config.ts inlined `z.object(...)` rather than importing `frontmatterSchema`.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:135:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:58:5. **Algorithm + runtime constant replication audit**: When an algorithm or runtime constant is replicated outside its authority (e.g. inline FOUC scripts, login challenge derivation, pre-hydration boot logic that cannot import from packages), audit every consumer-side replica for byte-equivalent reproduction. The replica must register a **regression test** that asserts equivalence against the authority across a representative input corpus. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 1 — FOUC IIFE truthy-coerce vs `getInitialTheme()` strict-whitelist; remediated with `apps/site/src/__tests__/fouc-script.test.ts` 16-row corpus.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:136:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:60:6. **Sister-file documentation audit**: After updating one CONTRACT.md (or any document that describes a code surface), audit ALL related CONTRACT.md files in the package family for sister-file drift. Two CONTRACT.md files that describe two halves of the same contract must use **identical terminology** for the shared identifiers (function names, schema names, refine predicate names). (Wave 1 evidence: instance #5 — `editor-commands/CONTRACT.md` updated to cite `editBlockInputSchema` while `agent-tools/CONTRACT.md` still referred to the old shape.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:137:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:62:7. **Exception-scope equivalence audit**: When replicating an algorithm + its exception handling across files, audit BOTH the happy-path semantics AND the `try/catch` scope between authority and replica. Narrow vs wide `try/catch` can produce divergent fall-through behavior even with identical happy-path logic. Specifically: when `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / `IndexedDB` / `matchMedia` / any browser API in the algorithm path can throw, the `try/catch` MUST wrap ONLY the throwing call, with the fall-through branch (matchMedia / system default / DOM apply) running AFTER the catch handler — not inside it. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #7 — FOUC IIFE wide-scope try/catch swallowed matchMedia exceptions; remediated with narrow try/catch + 2 storage-throws regression tests.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:138:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:64:8. **Authority-document → generated/consumed surface audit**: When updating an authority document (ADR, spec, `agent-contract.md`, runbook, CONVENTIONS) **OR a dependency authority (`package.json`)** that mandates behavior in downstream consumers, audit every consumer-side replica/generated artifact for synchronized update **AND staged-in-the-git-index in the same bundle**. Specifically: an ADR section that says "X file MUST be updated to do Y" requires the same commit to update X and provide a way to verify the synchronization. Generated artifacts (e.g. `docs/review-checklist.md` and `.claude/agents/*.md` derived from `agent-contract.md`; **`pnpm-lock.yaml` derived from `package.json`** — see sub-form C below) MUST be regenerated via the documented codegen step (`pnpm generate:configs` / `pnpm install`) AND **explicitly `git add`'d** so the git **index** (not just the working tree) contains the new content; runbooks (`docs/runbooks/team-operations.md`) MUST be cross-linked; Codex/Claude subagent prompt files MUST embed or reference the new rule.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-G1-code-review.txt:1006:    88	   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2104:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2758:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1963:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:398:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:56:4. **Consumer schema audit**: After defining a schema in a single-authority package (e.g. `@skb/content-types/frontmatterSchema`), audit every consumer for inline duplicates or inline redefinitions that should `import` instead. The "deferred swap" pattern — "I'll inline now and import later" — is a contract break that compounds over time. /home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2105:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2759:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1964:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:399:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:58:5. **Algorithm + runtime constant replication audit**: When an algorithm or runtime constant is replicated outside its authority (e.g. inline FOUC scripts, login challenge derivation, pre-hydration boot logic that cannot import from packages), audit every consumer-side replica for byte-equivalent reproduction. The replica must register a **regression test** that asserts equivalence against the authority across a representative input corpus. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 1 — FOUC IIFE truthy-coerce vs `getInitialTheme()` strict-whitelist; remediated with `apps/site/src/__tests__/fouc-script.test.ts` 16-row corpus.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2106:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2760:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1965:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:400:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:60:6. **Sister-file documentation audit**: After updating one CONTRACT.md (or any document that describes a code surface), audit ALL related CONTRACT.md files in the package family for sister-file drift. Two CONTRACT.md files that describe two halves of the same contract must use **identical terminology** for the shared identifiers (function names, schema names, refine predicate names). (Wave 1 evidence: instance #5 — `editor-commands/CONTRACT.md` updated to cite `editBlockInputSchema` while `agent-tools/CONTRACT.md` still referred to the old shape.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2107:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2761:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1966:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:401:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:62:7. **Exception-scope equivalence audit**: When replicating an algorithm + its exception handling across files, audit BOTH the happy-path semantics AND the `try/catch` scope between authority and replica. Narrow vs wide `try/catch` can produce divergent fall-through behavior even with identical happy-path logic. Specifically: when `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / `IndexedDB` / `matchMedia` / any browser API in the algorithm path can throw, the `try/catch` MUST wrap ONLY the throwing call, with the fall-through branch (matchMedia / system default / DOM apply) running AFTER the catch handler — not inside it. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #7 — FOUC IIFE wide-scope try/catch swallowed matchMedia exceptions; remediated with narrow try/catch + 2 storage-throws regression tests.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2108:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2762:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1967:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:402:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:64:8. **Authority-document → generated/consumed surface audit**: When updating an authority document (ADR, spec, `agent-contract.md`, runbook, CONVENTIONS) **OR a dependency authority (`package.json`)** that mandates behavior in downstream consumers, audit every consumer-side replica/generated artifact for synchronized update **AND staged-in-the-git-index in the same bundle**. Specifically: an ADR section that says "X file MUST be updated to do Y" requires the same commit to update X and provide a way to verify the synchronization. Generated artifacts (e.g. `docs/review-checklist.md` and `.claude/agents/*.md` derived from `agent-contract.md`; **`pnpm-lock.yaml` derived from `package.json`** — see sub-form C below) MUST be regenerated via the documented codegen step (`pnpm generate:configs` / `pnpm install`) AND **explicitly `git add`'d** so the git **index** (not just the working tree) contains the new content; runbooks (`docs/runbooks/team-operations.md`) MUST be cross-linked; Codex/Claude subagent prompt files MUST embed or reference the new rule.
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2109:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2763:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1968:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:403:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:68:   # 1. Edit authority + generator code
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2110:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2764:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1969:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:404:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:82:   **Pitfall (this is the load-bearing step)**: `git status --short` shows two columns: column 1 is index-vs-HEAD; column 2 is working-tree-vs-index. After running the generator without `git add`, you see `' M'` (space + M) — **working tree differs from index, but index still matches HEAD**. `git commit` only commits the index. Skipping `git add` means the regenerated content is in your working tree but NOT in the next commit. The bundle would land authority + generator-code changes WITHOUT the regenerated outputs, leaving consumers (Wave 2 reviewers reading `.claude/agents/*.md`) at pre-update content. Use `git diff --cached` (not `git status`) as the canonical staging-verification command — `--cached` shows index-vs-HEAD only, which is what `git commit` will produce.
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2111:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2765:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1970:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:405:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:84:   **Pitfall extension — `pnpm-lock.yaml` is a generated artifact too (sub-form C below)**: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump / `@types/*` shift), `pnpm install` regenerates `pnpm-lock.yaml` as a deterministic derived artifact. Skipping `git add pnpm-lock.yaml` produces the same class of failure as skipping `git add .claude/agents/*.md`: working tree has the synced lockfile but the **index** still holds HEAD's stale lockfile, so the bundle ships `package.json` ahead of its lockfile. CI runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` from the bundled state, sees the stale lockfile disagreeing with the new `package.json`, and fails install. The same `git diff --cached --stat -- pnpm-lock.yaml` canonical verification applies. (Wave 1 erratum commit `e15ec36`; codified as sub-form C below.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2112:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2766:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1971:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:406:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:86:   Generated-from-authority files carry their own header comment ("GENERATED FROM agent-contract.md — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND") OR YAML frontmatter declaring authority source — both forms are acceptable. `pnpm-lock.yaml` lacks an explicit header (the format is fixed by pnpm) but is implicitly declared by `pnpm install`'s contract — its authority is `package.json` + the workspace `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2113:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2767:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:1972:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:407:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:88:   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2213:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2872:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2098:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:586:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-pre-task-0-followup-code-review.txt:613:   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2321:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2984:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2230:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:1059:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-pre-task-0-followup2-code-review-r2.txt:929:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:17:Across 6 tracks + 5 close-ceremony fix iterations, codex 5.5 (`pr-gate`) caught **12 instances** of this meta-class (8 distinct failure-mode items + 4 close-ceremony reinforcements of items #6 and #8). Every PR that lasted ≥ 2 review rounds hit at least one instance. The pattern is so consistent that linear "fix the cited blocker, ship v_n+1" iteration would not have caught the second-order asymmetry; codex specifically catches the symmetric counterpart that the worker missed.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2324:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:2987:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2233:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:1062:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-pre-task-0-followup2-code-review-r2.txt:932:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:88:   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2557:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3226:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2585:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A1-pr-gate.txt:1976:   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2586:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3255:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2639:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:131:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:50:1. **Field/attribute audit**: After adding a field to a data shape (Zod schema, Pydantic model, TS interface, mdast attrs, etc.), audit every comparator / equality / serialization / canonicalization function that handles this shape. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #4 — `marksEqual` link branch missed `title` when serialize emitted it.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2587:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3256:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2640:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:132:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:52:2. **Status code audit**: After adding a status code to one HTTP handler (or, generally, an exit/error code to one branch), audit every other handler emitting the same code. RFC-mandated headers (RFC 7235 `WWW-Authenticate` on 401, RFC 7231 `Allow` on 405) attach to **the status code itself**, not the framework code path that emitted it. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #2 — custom `SkbError` 401 path missed `WWW-Authenticate`.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2588:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3257:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2641:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:133:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:54:3. **Strictness audit**: After adding `.strict()` (Zod) / `extra='forbid'` (Pydantic) at one level of an object schema, audit every nested object/sub-schema. The strictness setting **does not propagate**; nested objects must opt in independently. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #3 — top-level `.strict()` shipped while nested `frontmatterSchema` still silently stripped unknown keys.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2589:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3258:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2642:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:134:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:56:4. **Consumer schema audit**: After defining a schema in a single-authority package (e.g. `@skb/content-types/frontmatterSchema`), audit every consumer for inline duplicates or inline redefinitions that should `import` instead. The "deferred swap" pattern — "I'll inline now and import later" — is a contract break that compounds over time. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 2 — apps/site/content.config.ts inlined `z.object(...)` rather than importing `frontmatterSchema`.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2590:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3259:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2643:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:135:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:58:5. **Algorithm + runtime constant replication audit**: When an algorithm or runtime constant is replicated outside its authority (e.g. inline FOUC scripts, login challenge derivation, pre-hydration boot logic that cannot import from packages), audit every consumer-side replica for byte-equivalent reproduction. The replica must register a **regression test** that asserts equivalence against the authority across a representative input corpus. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #6 part 1 — FOUC IIFE truthy-coerce vs `getInitialTheme()` strict-whitelist; remediated with `apps/site/src/__tests__/fouc-script.test.ts` 16-row corpus.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2591:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3260:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2644:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:136:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:60:6. **Sister-file documentation audit**: After updating one CONTRACT.md (or any document that describes a code surface), audit ALL related CONTRACT.md files in the package family for sister-file drift. Two CONTRACT.md files that describe two halves of the same contract must use **identical terminology** for the shared identifiers (function names, schema names, refine predicate names). (Wave 1 evidence: instance #5 — `editor-commands/CONTRACT.md` updated to cite `editBlockInputSchema` while `agent-tools/CONTRACT.md` still referred to the old shape.)
/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2592:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3261:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2645:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B1-code-review.txt:137:docs/decisions/ADR-0006-asymmetry-audit-checklist.md:62:7. **Exception-scope equivalence audit**: When replicating an algorithm + its exception handling across files, audit BOTH the happy-path semantics AND the `try/catch` scope between authority and replica. Narrow vs wide `try/catch` can produce divergent fall-through behavior even with identical happy-path logic. Specifically: when `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / `IndexedDB` / `matchMedia` / any browser API in the algorithm path can throw, the `try/catch` MUST wrap ONLY the throwing call, with the fall-through branch (matchMedia / system default / DOM apply) running AFTER the catch handler — not inside it. (Wave 1 evidence: instance #7 — FOUC IIFE wide-scope try/catch swallowed matchMedia exceptions; remediated with narrow try/catch + 2 storage-throws regression tests.)

Specifically: an ADR section that says "X file MUST be updated to do Y" requires the same commit to update X and provide a way to verify the synchronization. Generated artifacts (e.g. `docs/review-checklist.md` and `.claude/agents/*.md` derived from `agent-contract.md`; **`pnpm-lock.yaml` derived from `package.json`** — see sub-form C below) MUST be regenerated via the documented codegen step (`pnpm generate:configs` / `pnpm install`) AND **explicitly `git add`'d** so the git **index** (not just the working tree) contains the new content; runbooks (`docs/runbooks/team-operations.md`) MUST be cross-linked; Codex/Claude subagent prompt files MUST embed or reference the new rule.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2655:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3327:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:2764:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-pre-task-0-followup-code-review.txt:613:   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2711:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3385:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:3064:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-I1-code-review.txt:2331:   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

/home/weiyi/selfKnowledgeBaseWeb/docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate-r2.txt:2877:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-A2-pr-gate-r3.txt:3559:docs/audits/codex-runs/2026-04-30-task-B2-pr-gate.txt:4019:    88	   **Wave 1 evidence**: **instance #8** — ADR-0006 v1 commit codified reviewer-prompt mandates but did not update `agent-contract.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` / regenerate `.claude/agents/pr-gate.md` / cross-link `team-operations.md` / regenerate `docs/review-checklist.md`; pr-gate caught the dogfood failure during R1 review of the close-ceremony bundle, forcing a v2 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form A — pre-regeneration omission)** — v5 bundle updated authority files (`agent-contract.md`, generator code, `team-operations.md` cross-link) but had not run the generator at all post-edit; the 3 regenerated outputs were stale at HEAD content; pr-gate caught this during R2 review, forcing a v6 fix. **instance #12 (sub-form B — staging-vs-working-tree confusion)** — v6 bundle ran the generator (so working tree had new content) but did NOT `git add` the regenerated outputs; the git **index** still held HEAD blob hashes for the 3 generated files; orchestrator confused `git status --short` "M" prefix (working-tree-vs-index) with index-vs-HEAD; pr-gate caught this via `git ls-files --stage` blob-hash comparison during R3 review, forcing the v7 fix that explicitly stages with `git add` + verifies via `git diff --cached`. **instance #12 (sub-form C — lockfile is a generated-from-authority artifact)** — Wave 1 close ceremony commit `e15ec36` ("fix(deps): commit pnpm-lock.yaml for @tailwindcss/typography (lockfile drift)"): the design-tokens erratum (commit `fdc86a8`) added the `@tailwindcss/typography` dependency to `package.json` but did not stage the regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; CI install used the pre-update lockfile, drifted against the new `package.json`, and failed `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Resolution: commit `e15ec36` staged the lockfile separately. Lesson codified: when the authority is `package.json` (any dependency add / remove / version bump), `pnpm-lock.yaml` is the consumer-side generated artifact and must ride the same bundle — the class equivalence to `.claude/agents/*.md` regeneration is exact (deterministic derive + git-index staging required). The four sub-forms of the same item #8 class — pre-regeneration omission, post-regeneration commit-staging confusion, conceptually-correct-but-operationally-incomplete fix, AND lockfile-as-generated-artifact — together motivate the explicit operational sequence and `git diff --cached` canonical verification command codified above.

     3	export const toolbarButtonSchema = z
     4	  .object({
     5	    id: z.string().min(1),
     6	    command: z.string().min(1),
     7	    icon: z.string().min(1),
     8	    label: z.string().min(1),
     9	    shortcut: z.string().optional(),
    10	  })
    11	  .strict();
    12	
    13	export const toolbarConfigSchema = z
    14	  .object({
    15	    buttons: z.array(toolbarButtonSchema).min(1),
    16	  })
    17	  .strict();
    18	
    19	export type ToolbarButton = z.infer<typeof toolbarButtonSchema>;
    20	export type ToolbarConfig = z.infer<typeof toolbarConfigSchema>;

     1	import type { ChainedCommands, Editor } from '@tiptap/core';
     2	
     3	interface ProseChainedCommands {
     4	  focus: () => ProseChainedCommands;
     5	  run: () => boolean;
     6	  toggleBold: () => ProseChainedCommands;
     7	  toggleItalic: () => ProseChainedCommands;
     8	  toggleStrike: () => ProseChainedCommands;
     9	  toggleCode: () => ProseChainedCommands;
    10	  toggleHeading: (attrs: { level: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 }) => ProseChainedCommands;
    11	  toggleBulletList: () => ProseChainedCommands;
    12	  toggleOrderedList: () => ProseChainedCommands;
    13	}
    14	
    15	export function runDefaultCommand(
    16	  name: string,
    17	  chain: ChainedCommands,
    18	): boolean {
    19	  const focused = (chain as unknown as ProseChainedCommands).focus();
    20	  switch (name) {
    21	    case 'toggleBold':
    22	      return focused.toggleBold().run();
    23	    case 'toggleItalic':
    24	      return focused.toggleItalic().run();
    25	    case 'toggleStrike':
    26	      return focused.toggleStrike().run();
    27	    case 'toggleCode':
    28	      return focused.toggleCode().run();
    29	    case 'toggleHeading1':
    30	      return focused.toggleHeading({ level: 1 }).run();
    31	    case 'toggleHeading2':
    32	      return focused.toggleHeading({ level: 2 }).run();
    33	    case 'toggleHeading3':
    34	      return focused.toggleHeading({ level: 3 }).run();
    35	    case 'toggleBulletList':
    36	      return focused.toggleBulletList().run();
    37	    case 'toggleOrderedList':
    38	      return focused.toggleOrderedList().run();
    39	    default:
    40	      return false;
    41	  }
    42	}
    43	
    44	export function isDefaultCommandActive(
    45	  editor: Editor,
    46	  command: string,
    47	): boolean {
    48	  switch (command) {
    49	    case 'toggleBold':
    50	      return editor.isActive('bold');
    51	    case 'toggleItalic':
    52	      return editor.isActive('italic');
    53	    case 'toggleStrike':
    54	      return editor.isActive('strike');
    55	    case 'toggleCode':
    56	      return editor.isActive('code');
    57	    case 'toggleHeading1':
    58	      return editor.isActive('heading', { level: 1 });
    59	    case 'toggleHeading2':
    60	      return editor.isActive('heading', { level: 2 });
    61	    case 'toggleHeading3':
    62	      return editor.isActive('heading', { level: 3 });
    63	    case 'toggleBulletList':
    64	      return editor.isActive('bulletList');
    65	    case 'toggleOrderedList':
    66	      return editor.isActive('orderedList');
    67	    default:
    68	      return false;
    69	  }
    70	}
